app_store.name: Alcove: Thinking Space
app_store.subtitle: Chats, projects, artifacts
app_store.promotional_text: Usage you can read: messages used, messages left, and the exact reset time.
app_store.description:
Alcove is a calm workspace for thinking with an assistant, and it shows the budget before you spend it.

One message counts once. The sidebar shows how many are left and when the window resets, so the wall never arrives without warning.

What is inside:
- Chats that stream, stop, retry, and keep every thread you have had
- Projects with their own instructions and knowledge, kept apart from each other
- Artifacts with a live preview, versions, copy and download
- Response styles, extended thinking, and a model picker
- Search across chats, projects and messages
- Incognito threads that are never saved
- Share links that are snapshots, revocable at any time
- One-click export, one-click delete

Honest note: this build has no language model behind it. Replies come from a scripted engine so the interface, the states and the counting can be judged as they are.

Flat pricing. Cancel in one click, in Settings.
